payload.title: ADR 0012: Proposing a week
payload.context: A person needs a week of drafts from the brief, pillars and slots, without unbounded spend and without anything publishing unapproved.
payload.rationale: Each slot of a publishable channel gives one time in the week; past times, times inside the lead time and slots already drafted are skipped; channels sharing an instant share one post. Pillars take turns by weekly target; ideas are taken oldest unused first, then loose ideas. A retry is a new run opened under the workspace lock. The daily limit counts only runs that reached a provider or are open, plus an instance-wide cap for the instance key. Stuck runs are failed by a scheduled command or by Stop waiting, never re-sent. The planned time is fixed at request time.
payload.consequences: The instance cap can overshoot by one proposal across workspaces. A stopped run loses the usage of an answer in flight. Queue retry_after default is 300 seconds.
